root_cause: The character count component incorrectly removes the maxlength attribute from the container div instead of the textarea, causing the browser's native maxlength limit to truncate input beyond 30 characters.
repair_strategy: Change the line that removes the hard limit to target the textarea element (this.$textarea) rather than the container ($module).
expected_accessibility_effect: Users will be able to type beyond 30 characters and receive accurate character count feedback, ensuring the summary field accepts the full input and conveys correct remaining/too-many characters.
functional_risks: If JavaScript fails or is disabled, the textarea will lack a client-side maxlength limit, potentially allowing excessively long input that could exceed server-side expectations.
verification_requirements: Typing 34 characters into the summary field should retain the full string and display 'You have 4 characters too many'.
Typing fewer than 30 characters should show the correct remaining character count.
The component should still enforce the 30‑character limit via JavaScript when enabled.
